_note: Real Google reviews, transcribed from Ash's public Google Business Profile. Names are reduced to first name + surname initial as a data-minimisation measure — the reviewers published under full names, but there is no need for this site to repeat them. Do NOT invent reviews: the AggregateRating schema is only legitimate if every entry is genuine.
_excerpting: Some Google reviews were truncated behind a 'More' link, so those are quoted as excerpts up to a natural sentence break. No wording has been altered. Two were trimmed further on purpose: one reviewer disclosed a health condition and another identified a wheelchair-accessible vehicle — special-category personal data that has no business being republished on a supplier's site. The praise is quoted; the sensitive detail is not.
_notIncluded: One of the 29 (Christian R.) left a star rating with no written text, so there is nothing to quote.

_howToAddMore: Paste additional REAL reviews into `items` as {name, rating, source, text}. The reviews page shows the first 6 and reveals the rest behind a button, so adding many costs nothing in load time.
_whyNotAutomatic: Google cannot be auto-synced on a static site: the official Places API returns a maximum of 5 reviews, needs an API key with billing, and needs a server. Third-party widgets can show more but inject heavy third-party JavaScript, which would undo the speed work.
